title: Illustrated burger mural

location.series: JKR / Burger King identity case study

slide_intent: Scale a recognizable gesture into the environment so a brand can communicate quickly across a street.
strategic_value: A giant held burger with a small signature can give Burger King a presence led by food rather than a large logo alone.
demonstration: A yellow mural on a building combines oversized pale lettering with an illustrated burger held by two brown hands.
practical_value: Compare the relative roles of illustration, type and signature at architectural scale.

content_islands.name: Mural
content_islands.spec: Place the held burger over large pale lettering on yellow, with a small signature below.

content_islands.name: Building context
content_islands.spec: Retain the surrounding facade, roof and windows to show size and placement.

reference_purposes.Application: Illustration, typography and signature are applied together to a large building mural.
